browser.title: Browser
browser.maxTabsWarning: More tabs preserve more page state, but they also use more memory and can affect video playback or sync speed.
browser.compactTabsDescription: Use a narrower tab rail on startup.

sync.title: Sync
sync.accelerationDescription: Higher values prefetch more pages during full sync. Large lists finish faster, but timeout or temporary Jable request blocks become more likely.
sync.fastWarning: Fast mode is more likely to hit 403, 429, or timeout responses. The app falls back to conservative page-by-page sync when that happens.
sync.autoReplayDescription: When off, favourite and watch-later changes made during sync stay in Pending Sync so you can choose Add, Remove, or Resolved later. When on, they are sent in original order and local data updates only after Jable succeeds.
